texts.title_text: Nepal floods: Two workers rescued after 9 days of search
texts.slide_1_text: Two workers trapped in a hydropower tunnel were rescued after nearly a week of search efforts
texts.slide_2_text: Rescuers confirmed voices from inside the tunnel, leading to the discovery of two survivors in the Upper Trishuli 3A site
